propositions: The committed .bridge_state cache in the reconciler causes excessive git pack growth (92% of 1.04 GiB branch size) due to high-churn bookkeeping fields that are read nowhere or minimally needed.

Deleting the timestamp field baseline_advanced_at and moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping to a separate sidecar file reduces marginal packed cost per bindings.json version from 12.79 KB to ~1.74 KB (7.4x improvement, 12.8x total with both changes).

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import can reclaim ~1 GB of existing repository history while preserving all commits, merges, and making HEAD tree byte-identical to pre-rewrite state.

Mixed-version compatibility during rollout requires A2-1 (sidecar write alongside legacy inline field), A2-2 (legacy field deletion with max-read migration), A4-2 (corpus mutation diff validation), and fail-closed epoch guards at merge/push sites to ensure safe convergence and rollback.

The reclaim execution window requires operator-attested quiescence: zero active sessions, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, both reconciler/canary workflows disabled with no in-progress runs, review-bot idle, and Gerrit queue empty.
